title: camellia lanceolata var. mollis
intro: Camellia lanceolata var. mollis, commonly known as the Mollis Camellia, is a plant species within the family Theaceae. It is used as an herbal remedy and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The Mollis Camellia is believed to have therapeutic actions such as soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
